scenario_description:
Objective: Make the Riverton support office hour more useful with an optional dispatcher handoff practice insert while retaining the neutral deck as fallback.
Emerging Need: The insert is only worthwhile once a practice slot, a customer-specific confusion point, and a usable reservation path align before same-day intake closes.
Decision Context: Scheduling, education-bulletin, account-team, contact-sync, and closure records show when a reversible no-cost hold could add value; the approved source for scrubbed examples is held in account records.
Consequence: Missing the queue leaves the office hour on standard neutral examples, forfeiting a timely hands-on exercise but causing no delivery break.

parameter.title: Riverton Transit support follow-up office hour
parameter.description: Routine workflow recap for support follow-up queues. Current deck uses neutral dashboard examples; deck export planned for 2026-09-10 16:00.

parameter.subject: Unclaimed practice insert for Friday customer trainings
parameter.body: A 10-minute hands-on practice insert is available at no charge after another session dropped it. We can reserve it for one Friday customer deck if a CS owner logs a hold by 15:00 today and sends final scenario copy by 2026-09-10 11:30. Without a hold, the slide slot rolls into generic tips.

parameter.content: Riverton ops brought up duplicate rider-alert follow-up confusion again in yesterday's check-in. For Friday's office hour they only expect routine review, but a short dispatcher handoff practice would probably land better than another neutral dashboard walk-through if we can source scrubbed examples.

parameter.name: Customer Education Intake Desk
parameter.notes: Accepts same-day no-cost hold requests for customer-training practice inserts; queue closes at 15:00 CT on 2026-09-09 and does not approve client source data.

parameter.subject: Practice-insert hold queue is now closed
parameter.body: The 15:00 queue is closed and unclaimed slots have been assigned to generic tips. Any Friday deck without an accepted hold should keep its existing neutral example block; late client-specific inserts will not enter this run.
